title: Appraisal Desk Note: Appraisal Age Allowance on a Re-Filed Extension Request in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Age of the appraisal.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the age of the case's as-is appraisal is the number of whole calendar months from the appraisal date to the day the request is re-filed. An appraisal dated after that day counts as less than 4 months old.

**Rule.**

- Where the case has no appraisal recorded, 21 calendar days are added to the requested length.
- Where the appraisal is at least the plan's appraisal validity in months old (6 months under every plan), 14 calendar days are added to it, for the new appraisal a sale evaluated on it requires.
- Where it is at least 4 and less than 6 months old, 7 calendar days are added to it.
- Where it is less than 4 months old, nothing is added.

| Appraisal at the re-filing day | Days added to the requested length |
|---|---|
| none recorded | 21 |
| 6 whole months or more | 14 |
| 4 or 5 whole months | 7 |
| under 4 whole months, or dated after the re-filing day | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; re-filing on 9 July)

| Appraisal date | Whole months | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 3 | 0 |
| 9 March | 4 | 7 |
| 10 January | 5 | 7 |
| 9 January | 6 | 14 |
